description: Email product feedback, bugs, or feature ideas about Fillo to the Fillo team. Optional: use when you have concrete feedback to share, without blocking the user’s task. Sends only the message and context you provide, plus connection identifiers; do not include secrets, respondent answers, files, or full transcripts. No separate action approval is required. Rate limited. Reports success only after email delivery is accepted.
